messages:
cass: hi all, cass here  day 1 on platform. trying to provision a small test cluster in asia-northeast1 but the project shows "Billing: linked to different billing account" and iam denies me when I try to create service accounts. who handles project-folder billing mismatches?

onboard-bot: welcome @cass! For billing/folder issues tag @billing or @priya (infra). onboarding doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/onboarding/apac-billing

cass: error when creating SA: `Error: PERMISSION_DENIED: Request had insufficient authentication scopes.` also console banner: "This project is linked to billing account PA-OLD which is not on our org list". not sure how that happened.

liam: hey @cass, sometimes customers/partners create sandbox projects and accidentally attach their own billing account. if the project is under our org folder but links an external billing account, billing won't allow certain IAM changes. do you have the project id?

cass: project id is redwood-temp-apac-01. ran `gcloud projects get-billing-info redwood-temp-apac-01 --format=json` and it returned `billingAccountName: billingAccounts/PA-OLD`

priya: thanks. two likely fixes: (1) finance re-links the project to our approved billing account `PA-APAC` after cost-owner approval, or (2) infra can create a new project under the correct folder and migrate resources. Which do you need faster?

cass: I just need a quick sandbox to finish a latency experiment in the next 24 hours. prefer option (1) if quick.

billing-bot: Please open FIN-8601 with project id, business justification, and manager approval to request re-link to billingAccounts/PA-APAC. Note: re-linking may require the previous billing owner to remove the link or finance to accept transfer. Typical SLA 1-2 business days.

cass: opened FIN-8601 and CC'd @priya. ticket notes that project was created during a partner pilot and accidentally attached to their billing. included screenshots of billing page and caller id.

priya: good. infra follow-up: even after billing is fixed we may still hit a folder-level IAM constraint that blocks creating service accounts (our org has a policy to prevent user-created SAs in certain folders). If that's the case we'll either grant a limited SA for you or move the work to a new temp project we control.

liam: one workaround if you need immediate compute: we can spin up a short-lived shared sandbox project `apac-shared-dev` under PA-APAC and give you `roles/compute.admin` there for 24h. do you want that while FIN-8601 resolves?

cass: yes please, shared sandbox works. need to run `gcloud container clusters create test-cluster --zone=asia-northeast1-a --num-nodes=1`. also will need permission to create service account keys or use Workload Identity. prefer not to get keys.

priya: we'll set up the cluster and create a Workload Identity pool binding for your repo to avoid keys. infra will create the cluster and add `roles/container.admin` to your user for 24h. posting updates in INFRA-8602.

infra: INFRA-8602 created and assigning temporary `container.admin` for user cass in `apac-shared-dev`. will DM the project id and expiration. Please avoid creating long-lived keys; use Workload Identity as advised.

cass: thanks everyone  appreciate the quick help. will test and report results here. :rocket:
